segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קפט
עִקַּר נְשִׁיכַת הַנָּחָשׁ הוּא עַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת, עַל־כֵּן צָרִיךְ לִזָּהֵר מְאֹד מֵעַצְבוּת וְעַצְלוּת:
segments.en: The true Tzadik who occupies himself to draw people close to Hashem Yisborach — he is the primary glorification with which Hashem Yisborach glorifies Himself in Israel. (Which is the aspect of His tefillin, may He be blessed.) For through him comes all the drawing close and the glorification.
